fact: CBC reports that Edmonton-based Karaar Digital Address has run multiple test pilots of a digital system assigning verifiable addresses to properties in Somalia, including in Merca, and has signed memorandums of understanding with four states and regions.
Somalia's Minister of Communications announced on 25 June 2024 the launch of the Somali Postal Service with a modern Digital Addressing System, with no coverage or use stated.

Mogadishu's mayor inaugurated a 'House numbering and post code system' for the capital, sponsored by the Benadir Regional Administration and Somali business communities, with property registration said to have started; no start date was given.
system: House numbering and post code system

fact: UN-Habitat says a Baidoa district mapping exercise registered over 21,400 properties and included road naming, road signs and fixed plate numbers.
